title: Composite multi-site cursor (decoded)
description: nextCursor the Control Plane returns to the Console for a multi-site PSP: base64url of this JSON followed by '.' and base64url of HMAC-SHA256 over the JSON bytes with a Control Plane secret. sites maps every site of the PSP to its site cursor (base64url of cursor.schema.json), 'START' (nothing consumed yet) or 'DONE' (exhausted).
